keyFindings.description: The repeated-label refusal (:557) tells the caller to 'rename or remove one with a document edit'. The tester showed a doc-edit rename is always refused, because it leaves the decision broken; removing one with doc-edit, then edit-ask, works (https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2433#issuecomment-6479217133). Name only the path that works. Requested by the architect.

refuseAskContentEdit compares items read by parseAskBlock, which takes only an item's first paragraph as plain text. A protected item's nested sub-list or second paragraph is not in the quote, so sending the quote back deletes it (Go probes against Postgres: 'only if finance agrees' and 'Finance must sign off first.' deleted); a link target and bold are flattened. The comment at :535, the Changed fragment and packages/envoy/AGENTS.md:2181-2187 say sending what it quotes loses nothing.

block.descendants (:230) never visits the block itself, so an unselected hr child of a broken ask is not protected (both reviewers' happy-dom probes: deleting it with the selection in the question applies, and the Yjs ask loses it); reachable only through a raw Yjs write. The comment at :207-208 says a block with no leaf holds nothing a collaborator wrote.
